```python
pp = fgt.get("password_policy")
admins_data = fgt.get("admins")
local_users_data = fgt.get("local_users")
vpn_ssl_data = fgt.get("vpn_ssl")

# chk-0001: Longitud minima de contrasena 12 caracteres
min_len = pp["min-length"] if "min-length" in pp else 0
min_len_int = int(min_len)
status_0001 = "pass" if min_len_int >= 12 else "fail"
evidence_0001 = "min-length=" + str(min_len_int)
report.finding("chk-0001", status_0001, evidence_0001, endpoints_used=["password_policy"])

# chk-0002: Complejidad de contrasena al menos 3 de 4 categorias
must_upper = pp["must-contain"] if "must-contain" in pp else ""
upper_ok = "upper-case-letter" in str(must_upper)
lower_ok = "lower-case-letter" in str(must_upper)
digit_ok = "number" in str(must_upper)
symbol_ok = "non-alphanumeric" in str(must_upper)
cat_count = (1 if upper_ok else 0) + (1 if lower_ok else 0) + (1 if digit_ok else 0) + (1 if symbol_ok else 0)
status_0002 = "pass" if cat_count >= 3 else "fail"
evidence_0002 = "must-contain=" + str(must_upper) + " categories=" + str(cat_count)
report.finding("chk-0002", status_0002, evidence_0002, endpoints_used=["password_policy"])

# chk-0003: Prohibicion de reutilizacion de ultimas 4 contrasenas
reuse_key = "reuse-password" if "reuse-password" in pp else None
history_key = "password-history" if "password-history" in pp else None
reuse_val = pp[reuse_key] if reuse_key else None
history_val = int(pp[history_key]) if history_key else 0
reuse_disabled = (reuse_val == "disable") if reuse_val else False
history_ok = history_val >= 4
status_0003 = "pass" if (reuse_disabled or history_ok) else "fail"
evidence_0003 = "reuse-password=" + str(reuse_val) + " password-history=" + str(history_val)
report.finding("chk-0003", status_0003, evidence_0003, endpoints_used=["password_policy"])

# chk-0004: Caducidad de contrasenas maximo 90 dias
exp_key = "expire-day" if "expire-day" in pp else None
exp_status_key = "expire-status" if "expire-status" in pp else None
exp_day = int(pp[exp_key]) if exp_key else 0
exp_status = pp[exp_status_key] if exp_status_key else "disable"
policy_ok = (exp_status == "enable") and (exp_day > 0) and (exp_day <= 90)
admins_no_exp = []
for admin in admins_data:
    adm_exp = admin["password-expire"] if "password-expire" in admin else ""
    adm_name = admin["name"] if "name" in admin else "unknown"
    adm_exp_ok = (adm_exp != "" and adm_exp != "0000/00/00 00:00:00")
    if not adm_exp_ok:
        admins_no_exp = admins_no_exp + [adm_name]
status_0004 = "pass" if (policy_ok and len(admins_no_exp) == 0) else "fail"
evidence_0004 = "expire-status=" + str(exp_status) + " expire-day=" + str(exp_day) + " admins-without-expiry=" + str(admins_no_exp)
report.finding("chk-0004", status_0004, evidence_0004, endpoints_used=["password_policy", "admins"])

# chk-0005: Forzar cambio de contrasena en primer inicio de sesion
admins_no_pwchg = []
for admin in admins_data:
    adm_name = admin["name"] if "name" in admin else "unknown"
    force_chg = admin["force-password-change"] if "force-password-change" in admin else "disable"
    if force_chg != "enable":
        admins_no_pwchg = admins_no_pwchg + [adm_name]
status_0005 = "pass" if len(admins_no_pwchg) == 0 else "fail"
evidence_0005 = "admins-without-force-change=" + str(admins_no_pwchg)
report.finding("chk-0005", status_0005, evidence_0005, endpoints_used=["admins"])

# chk-0006: Segundo factor de autenticacion en usuarios locales habilitados
def user_has_2fa(u):
    token = u["two-factor"] if "two-factor" in u else "disable"
    return token != "disable"

def user_is_enabled(u):
    st = u["status"] if "status" in u else "disable"
    return st == "enable"

users_no_2fa = []
for usr in local_users_data:
    uname = usr["name"] if "name" in usr else "unknown"
    if user_is_enabled(usr) and not user_has_2fa(usr):
        users_no_2fa = users_no_2fa + [uname]
status_0006 = "pass" if len(users_no_2fa) == 0 else "fail"
evidence_0006 = "users-enabled-without-2fa=" + str(users_no_2fa)
report.finding("chk-0006", status_0006, evidence_0006, endpoints_used=["local_users"])

# chk-0007: Sin usuarios locales autenticados solo con contrasena
users_pwd_only = []
for usr in local_users_data:
    uname = usr["name"] if "name" in usr else "unknown"
    if user_is_enabled(usr) and not user_has_2fa(usr):
        users_pwd_only = users_pwd_only + [uname]
status_0007 = "pass" if len(users_pwd_only) == 0 else "fail"
evidence_0007 = "users-password-only=" + str(users_pwd_only)
report.finding("chk-0007", status_0007, evidence_0007, endpoints_used=["local_users"])

# chk-0008: Sin usuarios locales en estado deshabilitado
users_disabled = []
for usr in local_users_data:
    uname = usr["name"] if "name" in usr else "unknown"
    if not user_is_enabled(usr):
        users_disabled = users_disabled + [uname]
status_0008 = "pass" if len(users_disabled) == 0 else "fail"
evidence_0008 = "users-disabled=" + str(users_disabled)
report.finding("chk-0008", status_0008, evidence_0008, endpoints_used=["local_users"])

# chk-0009: Tiempo maximo de inactividad SSL-VPN 5 minutos (300 segundos)
idle_timeout = vpn_ssl_data["idle-timeout"] if "idle-timeout" in vpn_ssl_data else None
idle_int = int(idle_timeout) if idle_timeout is not None else 9999
status_0009 = "pass" if idle_int <= 300 else "fail"
evidence_0009 = "idle-timeout=" + str(idle_int) + "s (max=300s)"
report.finding("chk-0009", status_0009, evidence_0009, endpoints_used=["vpn_ssl"])

# chk-0010: Tiempo maximo total de sesion SSL-VPN 8 horas (28800 segundos)
auth_timeout = vpn_ssl_data["auth-timeout"] if "auth-timeout" in vpn_ssl_data else None
auth_int = int(auth_timeout) if auth_timeout is not None else 999999
status_0010 = "pass" if (auth_int <= 28800 and auth_int > 0) else "fail"
evidence_0010 = "auth-timeout=" + str(auth_int) + "s (max=28800s)"
report.finding("chk-0010", status_0010, evidence_0010, endpoints_used=["vpn_ssl"])
```
